title: Chapter 139
text:
"The Germinal Organization's super soldier plan has been brought forward by a year?"

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows.

The original intention of this plan was to increase the strength of the test subjects through the use of exoskeletons to increase the physical fitness of the test subjects. Using pure mechanical strength to support the body, mass production of combat power comparable to Supers.

As the technology was very crude, the process was very painful. The exoskeleton ports had to be connected to the nerves, and the body had to be equipped with various mechanical components to strengthen the body. Only the Valkyrie test subjects with enhanced mental resilience could withstand the modification. The final result was that their sense of pain would be obliterated and their senses dulled. According to the standards of the universe, this was a very immature technology that had long been eliminated. However, on Blue Star, only the Germinal Organization, which did not care about the wear and tear of test subjects, had developed this technology.

The exoskeleton was not only a piece of equipment, but it could also be equipped. The latter was connected to the nerves and had better control. The Germinal Organization's technology was not mature, and they had only developed the prototype of the technology through a large number of clinical experiments.

The Six Nations each had one or a few class advancement knowledges. [Nerve Connection] was an advanced knowledge that was in the hands of the Germinal Organization.

Han Xiao only had one class advancement knowledge, [Advanced Materials Science]. If the players wanted to obtain advanced knowledge on Blue Star, they had to join the faction and contribute a lot. Han Xiao had set his sights very far. Advanced knowledge was very rare on Blue Star, but in the universe, it could be easily bought with a few Enas. If he could not obtain other advanced knowledge from Blue Star, there would be plenty of opportunities in the future.

In the original storyline, these super soldiers would indeed have a miraculous effect. However, the three super soldier test subjects in front of him were not complete, and they were equipped with a large number of firearms. The three of them only used exoskeletons to strengthen the body, and the exoskeletons were not complete.

"Looks like the Germinal Organization's research plan is not mature yet. Exoskeleton … speaking of which, when I escaped from the laboratory, I seem to have lost a Lightweight Mechanical Arm. It seems to have been taken by the Germinal Organization for research." Han Xiao's eyes sparkled. There was a reason for him to think this way. The arm armor of these three test subjects had the shadow of the Lightweight Mechanical Arm. It was very thick, and there were also round metal shields that could be expanded, blocking the attacks of the cannons.

The three test subjects separated from the convoy and dispersed the firepower of the turrets. The three of them successfully approached the turrets, and the fists wrapped in the steel skeletons bombarded the turrets repeatedly. The exoskeleton components rooted in the joints spewed out thick smoke to increase the output, and they quickly smashed the turrets into pieces.

Once they got rid of the remaining turrets, the trio went straight for Han Xiao. With every step they took, they moved seven to eight feet forward, and with a cold murderous aura, they came over in a menacing manner.

Han Xiao's eyes were calm as he took out his tablet and quickly activated another trump card.

The truck shook, and two second-generation Rangers drove out and blocked Han Xiao's side. They immediately activated [Burst Fire], and the large-caliber three-barreled machine guns in their hands unleashed a torrent of firepower. Small rockets were fired from their chests, and they covered the three test subjects. The damage rapidly increased, but almost all of them were blocked by the exoskeletons, and the durability of the exoskeletons dropped.

The attributes of these three people were also refreshed.

Based on your level, you can obtain the following information:

— —

Super Soldier Test Subject (042)

Level: 40

Class: [Agent] LV10, [Low Level Mechanical Implant] LV30 (END to HP conversion ratio: 1: 10)

Attributes: 51 STR, 54 DEX, 70 (80) END, 25 INT, 8 MYS, 4 CHA, 6 LUK

Energy: 0

Energy Rank: 500

Grade: E

Health Points: 534/650

Status: Rough Modification — -150 HP, -10 END

Talent: [Low Level Mental Fortitude — + 3 Will Resistance]

[Well-Trained — + 100 HP]

[Ignore Pain — Injuries will not affect combat effectiveness

Skills: Basic Combat Lv7, Basic Shooting Lv5, Grappling Lv3, Precision Shooting Lv1

Equipment:

[Crane Exoskeleton Arm (Right): As above]

[Predator's Leg (Right): As above]

[P-2 Embedded Plate Armor: Quality: Gray, Light and thin metal embedded in the skin, Provides some protection, Defense 15-20, Durability 500]

— —

The attributes of the three test subjects were considered to be very weak at level 40. With such a high level and weak attributes, it meant that they had no potential. An individual's health points were very low, but the defense and durability provided by the exoskeleton greatly reduced damage. Han Xiao counted, and this exoskeleton provided 1,460 points of durability and close to 100 points of defense, which made it very durable. These were the attributes provided by the equipment. If one only looked at the health points, they would have thought that he was a weakling.

The second generation Rangers fired a round of attacks, but only one-fifth of their health points were taken away.

Han Xiao realized that test subject 044 was actually at level 45, and his attributes were higher than his two companions. It seemed like he was the leader of the three.

On the other side, the Germinal Organization's fleet was making a detour, and the two Rangers' firepower could not cover both sides. Han Xiao immediately made a decision.

"You go and take out the red triangular-shaped briefcase from the cargo compartment. I have something for you to do!"

Mad Blade Angry Sword immediately carried the briefcase, which contained a powerful bomb. Han Xiao quickly wrote a mission and threw it over.

[Brave Sacrifice]: Turn into a brilliant firework with your unfulfilled dreams!]

Mad Blade Angry Sword subconsciously swallowed his saliva.

"Go, young man. I'll leave the stage to you."

Han Xiao said casually as he sniped the three test subjects.

"I — I got it …" Mad Blade Angry Sword gritted his teeth. The mission reward was very generous, and it would definitely make up for the death penalty.

The enhanced Red Falcon shot out one sniper bullet after another, leaving bullet holes on the three test subjects. Han Xiao's sniping ability was maxed out, and he could often cause damage to the body through the gaps of the exoskeleton, which could often avoid the armor. His sniping ability was perfect for these three.

Very soon, No. 042 was hit in the vitals, and his health was depleted. He fell to the ground and died. The other two did not care about the death of their comrade and continued to charge.

On the other side, the remaining armored vehicles were quickly approaching. Han Xiao moved the two Rangers over, and they exchanged fire with the machine guns of the armored vehicles. The orange-red dense bullets seemed to form a rainbow that connected the two vehicles.

The durability of the Rangers decreased rapidly. Seeing that they could not hold on any longer, Han Xiao ordered the Rangers to charge into the armored vehicles and self-destruct. The enemy could not dodge in time, and the dazzling flames engulfed the armored vehicles. A series of explosions occurred, and both sides perished together.

Losing two Rangers, Han Xiao did not feel any heartache at all. The battle style of the Mechanic class was like this, burning money … Hmm, he was indeed very wasteful. If it were a player, they would feel heartache, but who asked Han Technician to be so rich?

The firing speed of the sniper rifle was limited. Finally, the two test subjects were within thirty meters of each other.

Mad Blade Angry Sword remembered the mission details and jumped out, pouncing on No. 043. He was punched in the chest, and he spat out a large mouthful of blood. He gritted his teeth and activated the bomb in the briefcase.

"Boom!"

A mini mushroom cloud rose into the air, and a scorching heat wave mixed with dust exploded. Han Xiao, who was fully armored, was splashed with mud.

Through the smoke, No. 044, who was in a sorry state, rushed over again. At the moment of the explosion, No. 043 was the first to bear the brunt and was blown to pieces. No. 044 immediately laid down. At this time, he was still able to move, and his eyes were filled with murderous intent.

Only ten meters left. One second later, he would be able to punch that damn sniper in the head with his iron fist!

However, at this time, [Flaming Will]'s cooldown was over!

Han Xiao suddenly threw away the Red Falcon, picked up the Ghost sniper rifle, activated [Overload], loaded [Flaming Will], and fired a shot.

The bullet with a blue glow disappeared in an instant, leaving a bullet hole in No. 044's head. Blood spurted out like an arrow, leaving a long and narrow trail of blood on the ground.

Number 044's momentum did not diminish. He ran forward a few more steps before his body swayed and fell at Han Xiao's feet. He was only one step away from touching Han Xiao. There was a trace of unwillingness in his eyes.

Han Xiao had seen this scene many times before. In a battle with Mechanics, distance was the deciding factor. Countless enemies had died in the path of the charge.

"Too bad, even if you fight me in close combat, you will still die."

Han Xiao shook his head. He still had a lot of trump cards that he had not used yet. These immature test subjects were far from being his match.

[Second Promotion] Progress: 1/3

This was the easiest time to kill an enemy that was a level higher than him. The mass-produced assembly line soldiers were too easy for him to deal with.

"Two more."

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes. He was only two more levels away from the Promotion. There was a huge amount of experience on the interface, and he was looking forward to the Promotion.

Mad Blade Furious Sword sacrificed his first death and revived beside the truck ten seconds later. Looking at the mission reward and experience, he could not stop smiling.

The Germinal Organization team that intercepted him was annihilated, and the main battle had reached the climax. Stardragon's army and the Germinal Organization's ground troops were fighting fiercely. The battle was in a stalemate, and Han Xiao knew that there was no chance for him to interfere.

After thinking for two seconds, he quickly made a decision. He called Mad Blade Furious Sword, who was smiling foolishly, to get on the truck.

The truck moved, bypassing the main battle, and headed toward the Tedramira River.

…

In the base, Sleepy Winter was dumbfounded the whole time. He mumbled, "Am I seeing things? Is that Mad Blade Furious Sword?"

Han Xiao's battle was very eye-catching. When they saw Mad Blade Furious Sword's ID floating above his head, they were shocked. Twinkle Fried Rice was also confused. Even the cold Rainy Kim was shocked.

Sleepy Winter still remembered that Mad Blade Furious Sword rejected his offer during the beta test and did not join the Stardragon army. Why was he on the battlefield now? Moreover, he had even used a self-destruct method to kill a high-level monster. They had seen it clearly!

"If I'm not wrong, the man in black with him seems to be the Black Phantom that appeared in Big Horn Village not long ago," Rainy Kim suddenly said.

"Are you sure?" Sleepy Winter was stunned.

"I recorded the whole battle just now. We'll know when we see it later," Twinkle Fried Rice said.

Sleepy Winter was a little depressed. Mad Blade Furious Sword started from the same starting line as the three of them, but now he seemed to be ahead of them. This made Sleepy Winter feel a little pressure, but at the same time, he was very curious.
